description: This file defines the PermanentRedirectMiddleware class used within the AWS SDK for PHP to handle specific S3 redirects by throwing exceptions on 301 status codes.

classes.name: Aws\S3\PermanentRedirectMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class to intercept AWS S3 commands and throw exceptions on 301 Permanent Redirect responses.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method to create a middleware wrapper function.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the middleware with the next handler.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, processing the command and handling 301 redirect status codes by throwing exceptions.
